title: Density Matrix Definition
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly define the one-particle density matrix in the r-representation.

title: Final Expression for rho_1
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct limiting behavior of rho_1(r) as r approaches infinity.

title: Temperature Effects
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss the effects of temperature on the density matrix, particularly around T_c.

title: Mathematical Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show key steps in deriving the expressions for rho_1(r) and its limiting behavior.

title: Approach to Zero
description: Optional Criteria: The student should describe how rho_1(r) approaches zero as r increases, including any relevant factors.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the expressions for the density matrix and rho_1.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivations.
